name: Machine Learning and MLOps
summary: Where data engineering meets artificial intelligence.
prerequisites: Requires Python, SQL and a pipeline. This is engineering applied to models, not a statistics course.
syllabus: An overview of machine learning: supervised and unsupervised
The data engineer’s role in a model’s lifecycle
Feature stores and preparing data for training
MLOps: model versioning, deployment and monitoring

topics.title: Common tasks: classification, regression, clustering and recommendation
Evaluation metrics and the accuracy trap
The data engineer’s role in the model lifecycle
Deploying models: batch, real time and at the edge
Monitoring in production: performance, latency and cost
Detecting data and concept drift, and retraining
